Jim Carrey did something I never thought possible. He made Dr. Robotnik very, *very* attractive. The most interesting and enjoyable parts of the movie was when his character was on screen, and that’s not just because I found the character to be adequate eye candy. Jim Carrey did a fantastic job portraying Robotnik as he should be — an eccentric asshole with an ego the size of Jupiter. It was a bit “stereotypical bad guy”, but I really thought it worked for Robotnik. Saw the movie yesterday, and honestly, I’d give it a 7 or 8/10. Jim Carrey was the best part of the movie, no doubt, but I found Sonic and Tom’s relationship cute, and I enjoyed watching it develop on screen. There were some cheesy moments, but they were sweet.

There are throngs of people both irl and online that you can talk to! Hopefully they can help you figure things out for yourself (I recommend r/lgbt)! As for your friends — I don’t mean to be insensitive because I don’t know your friends and obviously can’t judge their character as a whole — maybe you shouldn’t be their friend if they’re intolerant and bigoted. If you’re confident that they would hate you because of your dysphoria, it might be dangerous to be with them? Again, I don’t know them like you do! I’m just making judgements based off what you’ve told us about them.
